limitations: User assumptions, not verified workforce facts, a forecast or staffing readiness.
One homogeneous workload scope; inputs assert disjoint movements and before-productivity workload. Aggregate values cannot prove no individual overlaps.
Start-of-month outflows are taken from opening stock, then inflows supply the full month. No within-month ramp or timing model.
Productive hours exclude non-work time; allocation is a separate share assigned to this workload. Productivity uplift is applied exactly once as throughput, not as fewer hires.
No costs, savings, confidence intervals, skill-match scores, hiring recommendations or action-plan effects are calculated.
